NFL Evil Fantasy Football History

Setup

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(nflreadr)
```

Data (Start 2025)

```{r nfl_data_25}
data25 <- nflreadr::load_player_stats(seasons = 2025)

wins_losses_25 <- nflreadr::load_schedules(seasons = 2025) %>% 
  select(game_id, home_team, result) %>% 
  mutate(winloss = ifelse(result < 0, 1, 0))

data25_full <- left_join(data25, wins_losses_25, by = "game_id") %>%
  mutate(loss = ifelse((team == home_team & result < 0) | (team != home_team & result > 0), 1, 0)) 

data25_full %>%
  filter(position == "P", pt_blocked >0)

```

Let's Just do QBs First

```{r data_25_qb}
data25_qb <- data25_full %>% 
  filter(position == "QB") %>% 
  group_by(player_display_name, week) %>% 
  summarise(evil_pts = 1*(attempts - completions) - 0.04*passing_yards - 4*passing_tds - passing_2pt_conversions + 10*passing_interceptions + 2*sacks_suffered + carries - 0.25*rushing_yards -2*rushing_tds - rushing_2pt_conversions + targets - receptions - 0.05*receiving_yards - 2*receiving_tds - receiving_2pt_conversions + 5*fumbles_total +10*fumbles_lost_total + fg_missed + 10*fg_missed_0_19 + 10*fg_missed_20_29 + 10*fg_missed_30_39 + 10*fg_missed_40_49 + 5*fg_missed_50_59 + 3*fg_missed_60_ + 5*pat_missed -6*pt_return_tds + loss + 25*pt_blocked) %>% 
  arrange(desc(evil_pts))

```

Evil Fantasy All Years

NFL Stats for As Many Years as We can Get

```{r data_all_years}
data_all <- nflreadr::load_player_stats(seasons = 1999:2025)

wins_losses <- nflreadr::load_schedules(seasons = 1999:2025) %>% 
  select(game_id, home_team, result) %>% 
  mutate(winloss = ifelse(result < 0, 1, 0))

data_full <- left_join(data_all, wins_losses, by = "game_id") %>%
  mutate(loss = ifelse((team == home_team & result < 0) | (team != home_team & result > 0), 1, 0)) 


```

Now Lets Get the Evil Points

Let's find the Best Evil GAMES

```{r evil_games}
data_all_evil <- data_full %>% 
  filter(position %in% c("QB", "RB", "WR", "TE", "K", "P")) %>% 
  group_by(player_display_name, week, season) %>% 
  reframe(evil_pts = 1*(attempts - completions) - 0.04*passing_yards - 4*passing_tds - passing_2pt_conversions + 10*passing_interceptions + 2*sacks_suffered + carries - 0.25*rushing_yards -2*rushing_tds - rushing_2pt_conversions + targets - receptions - 0.05*receiving_yards - 2*receiving_tds - receiving_2pt_conversions + 5*fumbles_total +10*fumbles_lost_total + fg_missed + 10*fg_missed_0_19 + 10*fg_missed_20_29 + 10*fg_missed_30_39 + 10*fg_missed_40_49 + 5*fg_missed_50_59 + 3*fg_missed_60_ + 5*pat_missed -6*pt_return_tds + loss + 25*pt_blocked) %>% 
  arrange(desc(evil_pts))

```

Lets find the best evil SEASONS

```{r evil_seasons}
evil_season <- data_full %>% 
  filter(position %in% c("QB", "RB", "WR", "TE", "K")) %>% 
  group_by(player_display_name, season) %>% 
  reframe(evil_pts = 1*(sum(attempts) - sum(completions)) - 0.04*sum(passing_yards) - 4*sum(passing_tds) - sum(passing_2pt_conversions) + 10*sum(passing_interceptions) + 2*sum(sacks_suffered) + sum(carries) - 0.25*sum(rushing_yards) -2*sum(rushing_tds) - sum(rushing_2pt_conversions) + sum(targets) - sum(receptions) - 0.05*sum(receiving_yards) - 2*sum(receiving_tds) - sum(receiving_2pt_conversions) + 5*sum(fumbles_total) +10*sum(fumbles_lost_total) + sum(fg_missed) + 10*sum(fg_missed_0_19) + 10*sum(fg_missed_20_29) + 10*sum(fg_missed_30_39) + 10*sum(fg_missed_40_49) + 5*sum(fg_missed_50_59) + 3*sum(fg_missed_60_) + 5*sum(pat_missed) -6*sum(pt_return_tds) + sum(loss) + 25*sum(pt_blocked)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(evil_pts))
```

```{r evil_seasons}
  reframe(evil_pts = 1*(sum(attempts) - sum(completions)) - 0.04*sum(passing_yards) - 4*sum(passing_tds) - sum(passing_2pt_conversions) + 10*sum(passing_interceptions) + 2*sum(sacks_suffered) + sum(carries) - 0.25*sum(rushing_yards) -2*sum(rushing_tds) - sum(rushing_2pt_conversions) + sum(targets) - sum(receptions) - 0.05*sum(receiving_yards) - 2*sum(receiving_tds) - sum(receiving_2pt_conversions) + 5*sum(fumbles_total) +10*sum(fumbles_lost_total) + sum(fg_missed) + 10*sum(fg_missed_0_19) + 10*sum(fg_missed_20_29) + 10*sum(fg_missed_30_39) + 10*sum(fg_missed_40_49) + 5*sum(fg_missed_50_59) + 3*sum(fg_missed_60_) + 5*sum(pat_missed) -6*sum(pt_return_tds)  + sum(loss) + 25*sum(pt_blocked)) %>% 
```
```{r evil_rb_single_game}
  arrange(desc(evil_pts))
```

```{r evil_ppg}

  group_by(player_display_name) %>%
  summarise(games_played = n(), 
            evil_ppg = mean(evil_pts)) %>%

  filter(games_played >= 32)
```
